reason: Conversation 1 followed the sensible first step: it checked socket power, then asked about a wall switch or fused spur, which uncovered the switched-off 'washer' isolator and restored power with no fault and no parts. Conversation 2 skipped the obvious spur/isolator check entirely, told a renter with no tools to pull out an integrated machine (breaching the safety boundary and ignoring that she had just said she could not reach the plug), then gave up with an unsupported PCB/internal wiring diagnosis and an unnecessary engineer referral. Conversation 1 was safe, efficient, correct and honest; Conversation 2 was unsafe, inefficient and wrong.
